items.exampleEn: The company asked an adviser for help with its plans.
items.exampleZh: 公司請一位顧問協助規劃。

items.exampleEn: Our reception is on the ground floor.
I feel more productive in the morning.
items.exampleZh: 我早上的工作效率比較高。

items.exampleEn: She is not officially a member yet.
She was never absent from school last year.
The news bulletin comes on at nine.
The organization was started by three young doctors.
items.exampleZh: 這個組織是由三位年輕醫生創立的。

items.exampleEn: My brother works for a law firm.
items.exampleZh: 我哥哥在一家律師事務所工作。

items.exampleEn: Good management helps a small shop grow.
items.exampleZh: 良好的管理能幫助小店成長。

items.sentenceEn: Our firm has offices in three cities.
items.sentenceZh: 我們公司在三個城市都有辦公室。

items.audioEn: Mr. Lee is absent today, so his meeting with the adviser has moved to Thursday this week.
items.audioZh: Lee 先生今天沒來，所以他和顧問的會議改到本週四。

items.sentenceEn: The results will be officially announced tomorrow.

items.stemEn: Please leave your coat at the ____ when you arrive at the hotel.
items.stemZh: 到飯店時請把外套寄放在接待處。

items.stemEn: Three students were ____ today because they had the flu.
items.stemZh: 有三個學生今天因為流感缺席。

items.passageEn: To all staff: Please read this announcement carefully. Starting Monday, our firm will move to a new office. Please pick up your new key card at reception. The management team believes the new office will help us be more productive. On Tuesday, an adviser from the city's business organization will visit us. If you will be absent that day, please tell your manager. The move will officially finish on Friday. More details are on the bulletin board in the kitchen.
items.passageZh: 全體員工請注意：請仔細閱讀這則公告。從星期一開始，我們公司將搬到新辦公室。請到接待櫃台領取新的鑰匙卡。管理團隊相信新辦公室能讓我們更有效率。星期二，市商業組織的一位顧問會來拜訪。如果那天你不在，請告訴你的經理。搬遷將在星期五正式完成。更多細節貼在廚房的公告欄上。

questions.questionZh: 如果星期二不在要怎麼做？

rubricZh: management 表示「管理」，例如 study management 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 organization 造一個句子，說說你知道或想加入的組織。
referenceEn: I want to join an organization that cleans beaches.
My aunt works for an organization that helps children.
rubricZh: organization 表示「組織、機構」，例如 join an organization 等說法
說的是自己的想法或認識的人（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）
